modelpilot.defaultExpert.description: Default expert profile when opening a new chat.

modelpilot.streamResponses.description: Stream responses token by token as they arrive.

modelpilot.compressContext.description: Automatically compress codebase files attached to context (stripping comments/whitespace) to reduce token budget.

enumDescriptions: Default - Prompt for approval on all modifying operations (human-in-the-loop)
Bypass - Automatically approve all tool and command executions
Autopilot - Automatically approve all tool executions and run autonomously
modelpilot.approvalMode.description: Approval mode for workspace tools and terminal commands.

enumDescriptions: Default - Automatically select mode based on request commands or user intent classification
Ask - Conversational support mode (equivalent to /ask, no tool execution)
Plan - Plan formulation mode (equivalent to /plan, generates implementation plans)
Agent - Autonomous agent mode (equivalent to /agent, executes tasks using tools)
modelpilot.defaultMode.description: Default mode of operation when no slash command is explicitly entered in chat.

modelpilot.maxAutoFixRetries.description: Maximum number of automatic self-correction retries when a terminal command fails. Set to 0 to disable the auto-fix loop.

modelpilot.autoGenerateCommitMessageOnSa.description: Automatically generate a suggested commit message and git diff summary when files are saved.

modelpilot.customInstructions.description: Custom instructions to personalize ModelPilot chat and inline code generation responses (e.g., coding style guidelines, project preferences).

modelpilot.mcpServers.description: Configure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The keys are server names, and values are execution configs containing command, args, and optional env.

modelpilot.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Enable inline code completions (ghost text) as you type. Uses the fastest configured model via the smart Router.

modelpilot.inlineCompletions.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after the last keystroke before a completion is requested. Lower values feel faster but consume more API tokens.

modelpilot.inlineCompletions.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per inline completion.

modelpilot.inlineCompletions.contextPref.description: How many lines of code before the cursor are sent as context for each completion.

modelpilot.inlineCompletions.contextSuff.description: How many characters after the cursor are sent as context for each completion (helps mid-expression completions).

modelpilot.pinnedContextFiles.description: List of workspace-relative file paths that are always injected into prompt context.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with ModelPilot
walkthroughs.description: Set up multi-provider AI routing and unlock all productivity features in under 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add Your First API Key
steps.description:
ModelPilot routes your queries across NVIDIA NIM, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, and Google AI Studio — all free tiers.

[Add API Key](command:modelpilot.addApiKey)

media.altText: Add API key to a provider

steps.title: Start Your First Chat
steps.description:
Open VS Code Chat and type ``@modelpilot`` followed by your question. ModelPilot automatically picks the best model for your task.

[Open ModelPilot Chat](command:modelpilot.newChat)

steps.title: Learn the Chat Modes
steps.description:
ModelPilot has powerful slash commands:

- ``/ask`` — Conversational Q&A (no file changes)
- ``/plan`` — Generate implementation plans
- ``/agent`` — Autonomous agent with file & terminal tools
- ``/terminal`` — Generate shell commands with Run buttons
- ``/commit`` — Auto-generate conventional commits from diffs
- ``/export`` — Save chat history as Markdown

[Try Agent Mode](command:modelpilot.newChat)

steps.title: Master the Keyboard Shortcuts
steps.description:
Speed up your workflow with these shortcuts:

- ``Ctrl+Alt+M`` — New ModelPilot Chat
- ``Ctrl+Alt+I`` — Inline Chat (edit code in place)
- ``Ctrl+Alt+T`` — Prompt Templates (10 curated prompts)
- ``Ctrl+Alt+R`` — Refactor Selection

Also: **right-click** selected code for Explain, Fix, Review, Tests, Refactor, and Docstring actions.

[Try Prompt Templates](command:modelpilot.insertPromptTemplate)

steps.title: Explore Advanced Features
steps.description:
Unlock ModelPilot's full power:

- **📊 Analytics** — Track token usage and cost savings
- **⚡ Benchmark** — Rank all models by speed
- **📌 Pin Context** — Always include key files in prompts
- **🏟️ Arena** — Compare two models side-by-side
- **🔍 Code Search** — Search workspace with regex
- **🔌 MCP Servers** — Connect external tool servers

[Open Analytics](command:modelpilot.showAnalytics)

steps.title: Discover All Commands
steps.description:
Open the Command Palette (``Ctrl+Shift+P``) and type **"ModelPilot"** to see every available command:

→ View Models, Refresh Models, Select Expert, Inline Chat, Benchmark, Pin/Unpin Context, Configure MCP, Compress File, Toggle Completions, and more.

[View All Models](command:modelpilot.listModels)
